>> reporter saw, then the layer that actually failed.


**What is NOT the fault (noise to pre-empt):** ‹e.g. "the 401s are correct auth

## 3. Detection & observability

>> How would anyone KNOW this is happening — and why wasn't it caught sooner?

- **How it surfaced this time:** ‹user report / log scan / alert / correlation across logs.›
- **Current detection:** ‹what fired, or "nothing — healthcheck stayed green / no alert exists".›
- **Observability gaps:** ‹what the logs/metrics did NOT show — e.g. backend has no
  access log; the real error is masked; healthcheck doesn't exercise the path.›
- **Suggested signal:** ‹the alert/metric/log line that would catch a recurrence —
  e.g. "alert on RouteExecutor ERROR rate" / "nginx 5xx-per-upstream" / "OOM kill".›
